scope: Fully synthetic complex intensity-Fourier coefficients only. No real Vandenberg coefficient, CPHD/SICD signal, download, dwell sweep, bathymetric inversion, commit or push.
times_source: BP12 effective irregular centres copied as fixed metadata from Block15G configuration; they are not a real coefficient input.

support.window: one separable Tukey alpha=0.1 response, same as BP12; no extra blur

primary_diagnostic.name: log_late_to_early_increment_energy
primary_diagnostic.formula: log(E_[12,23) / E_[0.6,2.0)); E_lag=mean_pairs,sum_support w_k |z(k,tb)-z(k,ta)|^2 / median_t sum_support w_k |z(k,t)|^2
primary_diagnostic.decision: B-detected iff score <= calibration A empirical 5th percentile; otherwise abstain; degenerate/missing class abstains
primary_diagnostic.false_A_to_B_constraint: calibration empirical false-positive rate <=10%; use conservative order statistic q=0.05
primary_diagnostic.utility: on evaluation: A->B <=10%, B detection >=50%, decision fraction >=40%, and held-out configuration B detection >=40%; otherwise stop as non-useful

families.A_band: three propagating finite-spatial-band modes; slopes use finite-depth dispersion and no unique frequency truth
families.B_static_observed: primary propagating mode plus an observed constant nearby coefficient
families.B_slow_OU: primary plus stationary complex OU nearby coefficient, tau=5 s

split.calibration: 24 sequences: A/B_static/B_slow x 8, radial 2.223 bins; ratios 0.3 then 0.7
split.evaluation: 48 sequences: A/B_static/B_slow x radial/tangential x 8, ratio 1.0
split.held_out: evaluation separation 3.0 radial bins or 1.452 tangential bins, both excluded from calibration

block15i_comparator: Frozen rule applied unchanged to the same new sequences: |amplitude-correlation|>=0.85 AND M1 predictive gain>=0.10; no re-calibration.
statistical_unit: one full Monte-Carlo sequence; pairs, lag classes and support bins are descriptive dependent aggregates
known_variable_transfer_control: not evaluated in the primary campaign. Its analytic non-cancellation is unit-tested; no real-data claim can rely on known H.
